description: $q captures only a restored T, whose saved value is ta. It is still present and keeps its own tags Mark, while $q.first-token and $q.value see the empty original span: the sound of the synthetic T is not the sound of $q. So $q.tags and $q.first-token.tags differ (engine §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a (A $q:q) %conditions ($q ∧ Mark ⊆ $q.tags), $q.first-token.tags = ∅, $q.value = ""

%rule q [+T="ta"] :: Mark
%rule b (A [+T="ta"] [+U])
%rule c (A T="ta")
